comments.mergedPostDetails:
Greetings again!
First of all thanks for all the comments and answers on the "multicore vrchat" thread.
And now to the main point: some of us use WMR for vrchat. But it is pretty annoying that the game (thanks to the wmr module for steamvr) sees the controllers as vive ones and as such we are pretty much forced to use the touchpads instad of the (imho) way better thumbsticks to move.
I know the thumbsticks can be used by changing the .vrsettings file on the wmr module, in fact i did that a while ago and i was enjoying vrchat like that. But the latest steamvr updates somehow outright ignored the settings of the wmr module and i´m now again being forced to use touchpads for movement again.

So yeah, having native full support for WMR will avoid that kind of hassle i think. Also i´m going to assume this is NOT easy (just in case someone cames out of nowhere telling that is just assigning inputs in the code and that´s it, sorry for th rudeness)

In any case... Thanks for listening and i hope there´s a solution to this (and the multicore issues) in the foreseeable future.
